Passive.description: Constant information flow during regular operational monitoring.

Active.description: Triggered instantly when the camera lens is covered, obstructed, or forcefully moved.

Dynamic.description: Fluctuates in real-time based on scene motion complexity (e.g., 15fps baseline, 30fps high motion).

Location.description: The exact physical coordinates where the camera hardware is mounted.

Equipment.description: Static hardware specifications including MAC address, SoC model, and current OS version.

Status.description: Binary indicator showing whether the internal lens defroster/heater is active.

User.description: Identifies the law enforcement personnel or operator currently authenticated to control the feed.

Operational.description: Tracks the hardware processor thermal readings and total hours of continuous uptime.

Service.description: Outputs from edge video analytics detailing bounding box pixel coordinates around detected anomalies or suspects.

RFID.description: RFID identifier scanned by physical field technicians during on-site hardware inspections.

Historical.description: Historical summary of connection drops and network recovery instances over the past day.

Spectrum.description: Wireless signal strength (RSSI) metrics and specific radio channel utilized for secure transmission.

Environmental.description: Ambient light intensity measurement, used to automatically trigger infra-red night-vision mode.
